title: Glessner's stable ridge runs straight on from the 18th Street wing
items: The ridge over Glessner House's stable, west of its little cupola, had drifted about two feet north of the 18th Street wing's ridge. It is back on the same line, so one straight crest runs from the east wing through the cupola to the alley gable, and the alley gable now stands even about its peak.
